sourceBasis.name: PolyBench/C 4.2.1 beta
sourceBasis.notice: PolyBench/C is by Louis-Noel Pouchet at Ohio State University. The 297,237-byte archive was fetched and verified at the recorded SHA-256. No PolyBench source or downloaded archive bytes are redistributed here; this package independently expresses the registered initialization and loop contract.

fixtureRecipe.cholesky: L0[i,j]=(-j%N)/N+1 for j<=i, L0[i,i]=1, zero otherwise; A=L0*transpose(L0)
fixtureRecipe.stencil: A[i,j]=(i*(j+2)+2)/N; B[i,j]=(i*(j+3)+3)/N; retain B boundaries; one A-to-B five-point sweep
fixtureRecipe.jacobi2d: Same A/B initialization; each of 20 timesteps performs A-to-B then B-to-A five-point sweeps
fixtureRecipe.determinism: IEEE-754 binary64 operations in source order; no random state

floatingPointPolicy.operationOrder: i-j scale then i-k-j accumulate for GEMM; i-j-k for Cholesky; timestep-i-j for stencil/Jacobi

oracles.independentNumericReference: Clang 22.1.8 compiles reference.c with -O0, f64, FP contraction disabled and fast-math disabled; complete JS and Wasm outputs are compared element-by-element with its retained raw f64le outputs.

counterScope.inputBytes: all target-consumed fixture arrays; stencil and Jacobi include both A and B grids
counterScope.typedArrayAllocations: per run from fixture initialization through returned output, including JS host linear-memory views; excludes worker/module initialization
counterScope.boundaryCrossings: zero for JavaScript; one exported kernel call for linear Wasm
counterScope.wasmLinearAllocations: zero because the fixed 64-page memory never grows
